text:
[Photograph: A diploma from Savoy Male and Female College. The document is partially legible. It reads in part:

Savoy Male and Female College

DIPLOMA

GRADUATES

DIPLOMA

[The following text is partially legible:] This [?] certifies that [?] is a member of the board of [?]

[Signature lines and seal visible at lower right.]]
notes: Page 54 of printed book. Contains a photograph of a diploma from Savoy Male and Female College. The text is largely illegible due to image quality and the ornate diploma script. A wax or embossed seal is visible at lower right.
